sql_calls.sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT date, units_sold, revenue_inr
  FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
), audits AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS date,
         COUNT(*) AS audit_count,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_count,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_count,
         MIN(audit_ts) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS first_empty_ts,
         MAX(audit_ts) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS last_empty_ts
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY audit_ts::date
)
SELECT s.date, s.units_sold, s.revenue_inr, i.book_on_hand_close,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand, f.ordered_units,
       a.audit_count, a.on_shelf_count, a.empty_count, a.first_empty_ts, a.last_empty_ts
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = s.date AND i.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = s.date AND f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN audits a ON a.date = s.date
ORDER BY s.date;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, MIN(date)::text AS first_date, MAX(date)::text AS last_date, COUNT(*)::text AS rows
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.stock_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM store.write_offs;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units,
  (SELECT SUM(line_amount) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_revenue_inr,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS bills_with_atta,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'on shelf' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS empty_audits;

SELECT d.date,
       SUM(d.units_sold) AS all_tracked_units,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.units_sold > 0) AS products_with_sales,
       MAX(d.units_sold) FILTER (WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_5kg_units,
       MAX(i.book_on_hand_close) FILTER (WHERE i.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_book_close,
       MAX(f.forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_forecast_units
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = d.date AND i.sku = d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-10' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
GROUP BY d.date
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT 'stock_count' AS event_type, count_ts::text AS event_time, sku,
       book_before::text AS book_before, counted::text AS counted,
       adjustment::text AS adjustment, trigger AS detail
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_off', date::text, sku, NULL, NULL, units::text, reason
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'goods_receipt', received_ts::text, sku_booked, NULL, NULL,
       units_booked::text, grn_id || ' / ASN ' || asn_sku || ' ' || asn_units::text
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE sku_booked = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY event_time;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS date,
       date_trunc('hour', bill_ts) AS hour,
       SUM(qty) AS atta_units,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS atta_bills,
       MIN(bill_ts) AS first_atta_sale,
       MAX(bill_ts) AS last_atta_sale
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-07'
  AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY bill_ts::date, date_trunc('hour', bill_ts)
ORDER BY date, hour;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS date,
       SUM(qty) AS units,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       MIN(bill_ts) AS first_sale,
       MAX(bill_ts) AS last_sale
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-07'
  AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY bill_ts::date
ORDER BY date;

SELECT date, sku, units_sold, revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG', 'ATTA-WW-5KG', 'ATTA-WW-10KG')
  AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-07' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
ORDER BY date, sku;

SELECT date, sku, book_on_hand_close
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG', 'ATTA-WW-5KG', 'ATTA-WW-10KG')
  AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-07' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
ORDER BY date, sku;

SELECT grn_id, shipment_id, sscc, line, received_ts, asn_sku, asn_units, sku_booked, units_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE received_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-07'
  AND received_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29'
  AND (asn_sku LIKE 'ATTA%' OR sku_booked LIKE 'ATTA%')
ORDER BY received_ts, grn_id, line;
